name: Pool of Archimedes
promptTemplate: A demoscene water pool with {{damping_style}} wave decay, a submerged {{tile_style}} mosaic, {{refraction_strength}} refraction depth, {{rain_density}} rain density, and {{palette_theme}} ambient illumination.

damping_style.hint: Controls wave decay and ripple lifetime

refraction_strength.hint: Distortion depth through the water surface

rain_density.hint: Frequency of ambient drops hitting water

drop_stone.hint: Cast your stone into the pool

listing.blurb: A water surface using the classic two-buffer wave equation: ripples spread, reflect off the edges and interfere, refracting a tiled pattern beneath; raindrops fall now and then, and anyone can drop a stone of their own.
listing.prompt: A water surface using the classic two-buffer wave equation: ripples spread, reflect off the edges and interfere, refracting a tiled pattern beneath; raindrops fall now and then, and anyone can drop a stone of their own. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
